func (r *MasterBindingRepo) ListMasterTargetsByShadowIdentity(ctx context.Context, shadowTable, shadowSchema, shadowConnectionKey, shadowBindingCode string) ([]MasterTargetIdentity, error) {
	var result []MasterTargetIdentity
	err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Raw(
		`SELECT mb.id,
		        COALESCE(NULLIF(mb.master_schema, ''), 'public') || '.' || mb.master_table AS master_fqn,
		        COALESCE(mcr.connection_code, '') AS master_connection_key
		   FROM cdc_system.master_binding mb
		   JOIN cdc_system.shadow_binding sb ON sb.id = mb.shadow_binding_id
		   LEFT JOIN cdc_system.connection_registry mcr ON mcr.id = mb.master_connection_id
		   LEFT JOIN cdc_system.connection_registry scr ON scr.id = sb.shadow_connection_id
		  WHERE mb.is_active = true
		    AND mb.schema_status = 'approved'
		    AND (
		      (@binding_code <> '' AND sb.binding_code = @binding_code)
		      OR
		      (@binding_code = '' AND sb.shadow_table = @shadow_table 
		        AND COALESCE(sb.shadow_schema, '') = COALESCE(NULLIF(@shadow_schema, ''), COALESCE(sb.shadow_schema, '')) 
		        AND (@shadow_connection_key = '' OR scr.connection_code = @shadow_connection_key))
		    )`,
		map[string]interface{}{
			"binding_code":          shadowBindingCode,
			"shadow_table":          shadowTable,
			"shadow_schema":         shadowSchema,
			"shadow_connection_key": shadowConnectionKey,
		},
	).Scan(&result).Error
	return result, err
}
flow: ListMasterTargetsByShadowIdentity joins connection_registry scr on sb.shadow_connection_id and filters by binding_code or shadow_table + shadow_schema + scr.connection_code.
